The description of the green TSEC line claims it stays at the 500 Euro level from 1993 to 1995, but the chart shows a clear drop from 500 in 1993 to ~400 in 1995.
The description of the green TSEC line is incorrect. The line starts at ~400 in 1995, rises to ~450 in 1996, and then falls to ~380 in 1997. It does not rise to 400.
The description states the green TSEC line falls to 300 by 1999, but the chart clearly shows it rises significantly from ~380 in 1997 to a peak of ~530 in 1999.
The description states the green TSEC line rises to 400 by 2001, but the chart shows it falls from its 1999 peak of ~530 to ~320 in 2001.
The description states the green TSEC line falls to 380 by 2003, but the chart shows it rises from ~320 in 2001 to ~400 in 2003.
The description of the green TSEC line claims it stays at the 200 Euro level from 2007 to 2009, but the chart shows it continues to fall from 200 in 2007 to ~120 in 2009.
The description of the green TSEC line claims it stays at the 120 Euro level from 2013 to 2015, but the chart shows it falls from 120 in 2013 to ~100 in 2014, before rising slightly to ~110 in 2015.
